# Polkadot falls 5% despite new 2.1 billion DOT supply cap and reduced issuance - COINTURK NEWS
Polkadot (DOT) experienced a drop of around 5% on October 17, reversing much of its recent recovery as intensified selling activity weighed on the broader altcoin market. The move erased gains that followed a brief rally earlier in the month.
Market reversal follows weak altcoin sentimentTokenomics overhaul and its effectsInvestor behavior remains influential
## Market reversal follows weak altcoin sentiment
The price of DOT hovered between $1.16 and $1.18 after reaching as high as $1.29 on October 10. This pullback reversed a portion of the double-digit rally that began on October 9, when the token traded near $1.09 before climbing back to $1.24. The bullish momentum continued through October 10, but failed to hold above the $1.20 level over subsequent trading sessions.
On October 12, selling pressure accelerated, causing DOT to fall roughly 7% and close near $1.17. Although the cryptocurrency briefly recovered on October 16, it struggled to maintain gains and slipped below $1.20 by the following day.
Analysts attributed DOT’s reversal to overall bearishness among altcoins, with smaller tokens broadly declining as investors trimmed exposure to speculative digital assets. There was no discrete event unique to Polkadot cited as a catalyst for the recent declines.
